subject: Harbor Spirits Holdings / Riverside Liquors — Representation and Initial Inquiry
business_event: Buyer's counsel introduces herself to seller's counsel and confirms Harbor Spirits Holdings LLC is proceeding with the proposed asset purchase of Riverside Liquors. Requests confirmation that Bell & Mercer is authorized to represent the seller and asks for a copy of the existing premises lease and a preliminary asset list to begin due diligence.
expected_case_brain_impact: Opposing counsel formally identified and contacted. Matter is confirmed as proceeding. Counsel has requested the premises lease and preliminary asset list. No documents received yet.

subject: Riverside Liquors — Quick Check-In
business_event: Client checks in to confirm that counsel has reached out to the seller's side and asks whether there is anything the client needs to provide or do at this stage.
expected_case_brain_impact: Client has confirmed willingness to proceed and is engaged. No new facts introduced. Client awaiting counsel's guidance on next steps.

subject: Riverside Liquors — Confirmation and Lease Transmittal
business_event: Seller's counsel confirms Bell & Mercer represents Riverside Liquors LLC and Kevin Russo in the transaction. Transmits a copy of the existing premises lease for the Montclair location for buyer's counsel review.
attachment_description: Existing premises lease — Riverside Liquors Montclair location
expected_case_brain_impact: Premises lease has been received from seller's counsel. Lease is now available for review. Key open issues — lease assignment rights and landlord consent requirement — can now be evaluated. This is the first document received in the transaction.

subject: Riverside Liquors Acquisition — Lease Review: Initial Observations
business_event: Buyer's counsel reports to client on her initial review of the premises lease. Highlights that the lease contains an assignment clause requiring landlord consent and that the lease term and any renewal options need to be confirmed. Advises client that landlord consent will be a required closing condition and recommends the parties discuss lease assignment versus a new direct lease with the landlord.
expected_case_brain_impact: Lease review completed. Assignment clause confirmed — landlord consent is required to transfer the lease to buyer. Lease term and renewal options identified as open items. Landlord consent is now a confirmed required closing condition. Client has been advised.

subject: Riverside Liquors — Preliminary Asset List
business_event: Seller's counsel transmits a preliminary list of the assets included in the proposed sale — furniture fixtures and equipment trade name goodwill and inventory — along with a note that the seller will provide an inventory count closer to closing. Counsel notes that certain equipment may be subject to a financing arrangement and that details will follow.
attachment_description: Preliminary asset list — furniture fixtures equipment trade name goodwill and inventory
expected_case_brain_impact: Preliminary asset list received from seller. Included assets are generally consistent with client's expectations. Two new open items identified: (1) certain equipment may be subject to seller financing that must be discharged at or before closing; (2) formal inventory count deferred to a date closer to closing. Assumed liabilities scope remains open pending confirmation of equipment financing details.
